title: The Locket
novel:
On a warm Friday morning, the group began their [[journey|journey]] to Farhampton for Robin and Barney's wedding weekend. Ted drove with Lily, while Marshall was still traveling from Minnesota with his baby son Marvin.

On the way, Robin and Barney [[discovered|discover]] a startling family secret. They found out that they were [[distant|distant]] cousins, which caused them both to feel very [[anxious|anxious]]. However, they soon realized that the family connection was so far apart that it did not matter.

Meanwhile, Marshall's trip was [[altered|alter]] by something he saw online. He had to change his plans and travel with a woman named Daphne, who was [[annoying|annoying]] and difficult to deal with. The long car ride tested his patience.

At the Farhampton Inn, Lily [[confronted|confront]] Ted about his feelings for Robin. She noticed that Ted still kept a [[locket|locket]] that he had planned to give to Robin years ago. Lily told Ted that he needed to let go of his past feelings and [[move|move]] on with his life.

Ted [[promised|promise]] Lily that he would [[behave|behave]] himself during the wedding weekend. He [[decided|decide]] that after the wedding, he would move to Chicago to start fresh. Lily was [[relieved|relieve]] to hear this.

Robin was worried that she had lost her grandmother's locket. She had [[hidden|hide]] it carefully but could not remember where. The locket would soon [[reveal|reveal]] a deeper meaning. Barney tried to help her find it, but the locket remained a [[mystery|mystery]] as the wedding weekend began.
